description: BENE.BIZ Date Range Slicer visual allows users to filter data dynamically based on selectable timeframes, ranging from milliseconds to years, adjusting the filter context to reflect the specified period leading up to the current date. The slicer operates based on the user’s current local time and intelligently accounts it for filtering data. Did you ever wonder how to filter data by the last 24 hours, last 3 weeks, last year etc.? The BENE.BIZ Date Range Slicer visual is the solution for you! It significantly simplifies the creation of reports with “last period” filtering functionality. This functionality distinguishes it from traditional date/time slicers, which rely on absolute date intervals and typically become less user-friendly after data refreshes – often causing selections to become outdated. With the BENE.BIZ Date Range Slicer, report creators and users always benefit from consistent, up-to-date results for most current timeframes without needing to periodically adjust their filter selection to filter the latest timeframe. This ensures that your stakeholder will be able to see relevant results immediately after opening the report, without the need to adjust date/time filters to reflect the latest period.
